items.period: Early 12th century BC; Shang, oracle-bone period II per Commons description
items.tradition: Oracle-bone inscription on incised ox scapula; Shanghai Museum collection
items.caption: A Shang oracle-bone inscription whose published transcription includes 上甲. The source associates the bone with the early 12th century BC; the individual 上 glyph is not marked separately in the file description.
items.alt: Photograph of an inscribed oracle bone; the Commons description identifies an 上甲 phrase in the transcription.
items.selection_reason: A primary artifact photograph with a source-reported inscription containing 上甲 offers material context for an early attested use. Exact glyph localization must be confirmed by the separate pixel reviewer.
items.rights: Commons page states GFDL and CC BY-SA licensing for this artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The photograph is a complete artifact image rather than an isolated glyph plate; its description transcribes 上甲 but does not point to the glyph's exact position.
The two candidate Commons vector files already failed acquisition with 404 and are excluded. The Xiaoxuetang character query returned 401 with no image candidates.
